blockers.description: Extension wrapper on port 9183 still runs pre-change code until the Kiro window is reloaded. Backend adaptation is live (x-output-base64 visible in schemas) but the old wrapper does not write files from output_base64. DOCX export through the wrapper may not create a file.
blockers.impact: Jira DOCX attachments skipped; markdown documents unaffected.
blockers.action: User must reload Kiro window (Ctrl+Shift+P → Reload Window) before DOCX export via wrapper is usable.

blockers.description: A remote child that returns only a host-local path cannot be read by the backend (bytes live on another machine). Such tools must expose MCP resources/URLs or share a volume. ARTIFACT_PATH_MAP is a future option, not implemented.
blockers.impact: markdown-exporter-mcp-local works only while the child runs on the backend host (stdio/local); remote path-only setup fails by design with ARTIFACT_FETCH_FAILED.
